review.rationale: The overlay replaces a filtering predicate `GlhsAssertion.lifecycle_status.in_(ACTIVE_LIFECYCLE_STATES)` with the literal `True`. The original predicate restricts query results to records whose lifecycle_status is within the ACTIVE_LIFECYCLE_STATES set, excluding records with other statuses (e.g., inactive, deprecated, retired). Substituting `True` removes this filter entirely, causing the query to return all records regardless of lifecycle_status. This produces an observable behavioral difference: the governed system will return a superset of records compared to the original implementation, including records that would previously have been excluded. Any consumer of this API endpoint will potentially receive different data in its response.
